Body.Content:
What and Why:

Critique and Council were introduced as preview experiences in Researcher through the Frontier program, giving customers an opportunity to explore early capabilities and share feedback.

As we conclude this preview, Critique and Council will be retired. The insights from this preview will help inform how we evolve these concepts and explore opportunities to bring similar value into broader Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences in the future.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin retiring Critique and Council in late October 2026 and expect to complete by mid-November 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected:

  • Eligible Microsoft 365 Copilot users who are part of the Frontier program and currently have access to Critique or Council in Researcher.

Platforms/Services:

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot
  • Researcher
  • Frontier program preview experiences

What will happen:

  • Critique and Council preview experiences will be retired from Researcher.
  • After retirement, users will no longer be able to access Critique or Council in Researcher.
  • Researcher and Analyst are not being retired and will remain available to eligible users.

Action Required/Recommendations:

  • Inform affected Frontier program users that Critique and Council preview experiences will be retired.
  • Update internal guidance, training, or support materials that reference Critique or Council.
  • Inform your help desk before the retirement takes effect.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Details.Value: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Critique and Council preview experiences in Researcher will retire between late October and mid-November 2026. No compliance issues noted.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Critique and Council preview experiences will retire
